name: Truck crash
author: Techopanda
description:
Finally did it! Local multiplayer with oncoming cars. Struggled as player controllers were not working at first, but fixed by going to Edit > Project Settings > Player > Other Settings > Active Input Handling and switching option from "Input System Package (New)" to "Both".

Player 1: WASD to move, F to toggle cam
Player 2: Arrow keys to move, Right Shift tab to toggle cam
